label: a6-020-thm-the-separation-implication-chain
tail:
### FINDING 1 — NONFATAL — location: Statement, first paragraph
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "each is proved by an earlier item of this page."
WHY IT FAILS: The page contains exactly one item (this theorem). There are no "earlier items" on the page; the clauses are proved by the cited external dependencies ([L1]–[L8]), not by items that appear earlier on the same page. The statement is factually false about the page’s structure.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Replace with "each is proved by the cited dependencies" or simply remove "by an earlier item of this page".

### FINDING 2 — NONFATAL — location: Remarks, first bullet
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "This page refutes four of the possible converses among its false statements — $T_1$ does not give Hausdorff, normal does not give Hausdorff, Hausdorff does not give regular, and unique sequential limits do not give Hausdorff — and asserts nothing about the others."
WHY IT FAILS: The page as provided states only the forward implications; it contains no counterexamples, refutations, or even statements of those converses. The claim that the page refutes them is false.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Either add the claimed refutations to the page, or correct the remark to accurately describe the page’s actual content.

### FINDING 3 — NONFATAL — location: Statement, paragraph "This is the whole of the classical chain…"
CLAIM AS WRITTEN: "Its absence is recorded, with what would license it, in this page's conventions remark;"
WHY IT FAILS: The page has no section or paragraph titled "conventions remark" (or otherwise) that records what would license the missing implication $T_4 \Rightarrow T_{3\frac12}$. The sentence references a non‑existent part of the page, making the claim false.
WHAT WOULD FIX IT: Either add a conventions remark containing the mentioned information, or remove the dangling reference.

0 fatal, 3 nonfatal
